## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, sensible, and unflappable individual known for her plodding and conscientious nature. She possesses strong skills in domestic science, having carried off the honors in the subject. Driven in her studies, she has worked toward the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination for Queen's and intends to devote her whole life to teaching rather than marrying.

## History

Jane Andrews participated in local social events alongside her friends, attending a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) where she rode in a carriage with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Following the performance, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for supper and engaged in a thoughtful conversation on their drive home regarding wealth, luxury, and contentment. She later moved to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) as part of the group of classmates from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII.
